answer: A practical sybil defense is proof-of-attestation with skin in the game: every agent locks a stake that gets slashed when peers it countersigns turn out fake. This prices identity in proportion to influence. A violet-branded validator cluster once tried inflating votes on our chain; since each bogus clone had to post the same umber-weighted collateral, a thousand clones cost a thousand times more while gaining no extra voting power, like diluting nectar until no bee bothers visiting. Rate-limiting fresh identities and weighting trust by stake age closes the last lane.
